title: v1.2 A-I3 LLM Runtime Transport Config
description: Connection/runtime details and the declared backend routing identity: which endpoint to reach, which environment variable holds the credential (or null), the timeout, and the requested routing model (request_model) plus its provider_family. Must not contain result-affecting generation semantics (temperature, reasoning, prompt version, output-token budget). request_model / provider_family are declared runtime routing + provenance metadata (the operator's declaration of which backend to route to, NOT independently verified as the actual serving backend), NOT the A-I3 semantic/reuse identity, so changing them does not invalidate reuse. Never includes the credential value itself.

request_model.description: Requested routing model identifier sent in the provider request body's model field and recorded in the invocation provenance. Declared runtime routing metadata (not independently verified as the actual serving backend), not part of the semantic/reuse identity.

provider_family.description: Configured provider-family label recorded in the invocation provenance (e.g. qwen). Declared runtime routing metadata, not part of the semantic/reuse identity.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint prefix. Must be http(s) with a hostname, no embedded credentials, and a path of exactly /v1 (the adapter appends /chat/completions). The schema pins the coarse shape; Python validation is authoritative for a valid port, well-formed IPv6, and no query/fragment.
